comment: Test quarter of island (IslandQuarterTest.cs; sandbox room 5): a fan-shaped quarter, its point standing for the centre of the island (bottom left), its arc for the coast. seed: 0 = a new one each time (R or Select draws again). radius: tiles from the point to the coast; coastNoise / coastScale: how much the coast wavers and the size of its bays; sideNoise: tiles the two straight sides waver; voidMargin: sky around. River: from a spring sourceDistance tiles from the point (a pond of sourceRadius tiles) to the coast, along the middle of the quarter; riverWidth: tiles, at the spring then at the mouth (plus widthNoise); meanderAmplitude / meanderWavelength: tiles; wobble: share of the amplitude left to noise. bridges: how many, spread along the river (bridgeWidth tiles wide). left / right: the sub-biome on each side of the river (left when going downstream), its ROM décors (tilesets) and its colour on the mini-map.
